name: Jari Kärkinen
bio:
Jari's journey into motorsport started with a passion for tinkering. Growing up in a small town in Finland, he spent countless hours in his father's garage, disassembling and reassembling engines. This hands-on experience led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he joined a local rally team as a junior mechanic. His meticulous nature and organizational skills quickly became apparent, and he transitioned into logistics, ensuring the team always had the right parts at the right time. 

Now at the Junior Kart Team, Jari is the linchpin of their logistical operations. He prides himself on anticipating potential problems and having solutions ready before they even arise. While some might find his attention to detail excessive, Jari believes that in motorsport, even the smallest oversight can have significant consequences. He is known for his encyclopedic knowledge of kart parts and his uncanny ability to source even the most obscure components. What sets Jari apart is his innovative approach to logistics, constantly seeking ways to streamline processes and improve efficiency, often through unconventional means.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jari is of average height with a slightly stocky build and a serious expression.

quirks: Insists on labeling every item with excruciating detail.
Always carries a multi-tool, even in meetings.
Has an aversion to improperly organized cables and wires.
